candidate_relations.reason: The biopsy confirms CD20+, BCL6+, MUM-1+ large B-cell phenotype with EBV-negative status and diffuse non-enhancing white matter infiltration consistent with lymphomatosis cerebri variant of DLBCL. C001 captures the parent category (primary CNS B-cell lymphoma) but omits the required DLBCL specification and the lymphomatosis cerebri variant, which is the defining diagnostic feature in this case.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Correctly identifies primary CNS B-cell lymphoma but does not specify the lymphomatosis cerebri variant or DLBCL subtype

candidate_relations.reason: Multifocal leukoencephalopathy is a descriptive radiological/pathological term for diffuse white matter disease and can be a manifestation of lymphomatosis cerebri, but it is not the final diagnostic entity. It does not account for the confirmed B-cell lymphoma on biopsy and CSF cytology.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Describes the radiological pattern (diffuse white matter signal abnormality) rather than the underlying neoplastic diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Lymphomatosis cerebri is a rare infiltrative variant of DLBCL characterised by diffuse non-enhancing white matter involvement; the biopsy immunophenotype (CD20+, BCL6+, MUM-1+, EBV−) and FISH findings (BCL6 and BCL2 extra copies, no MYC) are consistent with non-GCB DLBCL
No physical examination findings documented, limiting clinical staging detail
